text: 4. Far from the major capitals of Europe, on a small island in a lake, there stands a church reached most romantically by traditional wooden boats. The site is tied to local wedding custom: it is considered auspicious for the groom to carry the bride up all the steps to the church. Surrounded by mountains and reflections, it is as much folklore as architecture. Which landmark is this?
Answer: Bled Island Church / Church of the Assumption (Slovenia)

5. In a dry valley, there stands a Nabataean monument often overshadowed by the more famous façade of Petra. Unlike Petra’s Treasury, however, this tomb sits more isolated, almost like a lone desert cousin carved into sandstone.
